heroLede: Fellowship, opportunities to learn and grow, activities throughout the year, and a series of repeaters across Greater Pittsburgh. New and prospective hams are always welcome.
aroundBlurb: From Field Day and satellite passes to license classes and the holiday dinner, there's always something going on — on the air and in person. New and prospective hams are always welcome.
